title: Seq2Seq & Encoder–Decoder Attention
interviewAnswer: Encoder–decoder models map one sequence to another. Attention lets the decoder dynamically focus on encoder states instead of compressing the entire input into one fixed vector, paving the way for transformers.

deepDive: Encoder–decoder models map one sequence to another. Attention lets the decoder dynamically focus on encoder states instead of compressing the entire input into one fixed vector, paving the way for transformers. Exposure bias can appear at generation time. Attention alignment improves long sequences. A strong practitioner separates the modeling assumption from the estimation procedure, checks diagnostics rather than trusting a single score, and explains what would make the method inappropriate.
